summary.zhCn: Dogecoin 共同创建者，最初提出名称、注册域名并组织项目；曾任 Adobe 营销人员，后来退出加密行业并公开批评投机结构。
summary.en: Dogecoin co-creator who coined the concept, registered the domain, and organized the project; a former Adobe marketer who later left crypto and criticized its speculative structure.

imageAlt.zhCn: 代表 Jackson Palmer 档案的 Dogecoin 标识；没有使用错误或未经许可的人物照片
imageAlt.en: Dogecoin mark representing the Jackson Palmer dossier; no misidentified or unlicensed portrait is used
